parameters.description: One key per diagnosis the person wants to make (a UUID fits): the first request and every resend of it, after a lost answer or a timeout, carry the same key; a new diagnosis (another photo or crop) needs a new key. The key is tied to the crop and to the exact photo bytes (SHA-256): another crop or another photo under the same key is 422 idempotency_key_reused with reason crop or photo, so a retry must send the same file. A malformed key is 400 invalid_idempotency_key. A repeat does not spend the diagnosis rate limit. While the first request with the key is still being processed, another one gets 409 request_in_progress with Retry-After: 2 (seconds); the model is not called again and the limit is not spent.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: The diagnosis; for a repeated Idempotency-Key the one made the first time, with the header Idempotent-Replayed: true

409.description: request_in_progress: a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed; repeat after the seconds in Retry-After

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before repeating the request

429.description: rate_limited: more than 20 attempts or more than 5 new diagnoses in a minute. Attempts are never given back; a diagnosis token is given back when the server failed (see docs/api/ai-predict.md). Repeat after the seconds in Retry-After

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the window of the limit ends
